active_continuity: Taekyung believes Ares Guild used mental magic to manipulate witnesses' memories after the confrontation and knows that Ares personnel searched his phone and shared cloud storage.
Go Jun is identified by Qi Sense and appears to have learned martial arts or a comparable combat discipline; Taekyung considers him unusually formidable.

Im Kkeokjeong regained consciousness after three days, has had both severed arms reattached, and must avoid strenuous activity for at least two weeks; his eventual return as a Hunter remains uncertain.
Im Kkeokjeong's wife and two young daughters visit him, and he has previously told them about Taekyung, whom they call Uncle Taekyung.
Butler Kim and Team Leader Choi funded and arranged Im Kkeokjeong's extensive treatment; Choi accepts responsibility for the Guild's failure to prevent the attack.
Im Kkeokjeong now knows that the investigation led from the Black Hunters to Myeongdong Guild, Ares Guild, and Lee Jungryong.
Go Jun accompanied Lee Jungryong to the hospital, and Lee Jungryong addressed Team Leader Choi by remarking that he had grown a lot.
Taekyung resolves that he must not repeat the mistake of failing to protect someone close to him.
Jin Taekyung defeated the immediate operation's attackers and forced Lee Jungryong to withdraw with Park Jihoon, though Taekyung sustained a slight Internal Injury.
Taekyung secured revenge and tacit promises of apology and compensation for Im Kkeokjeong, creating an opportunity for the Peace Guild to grow.
Team Leader Choi endorsed Taekyung's retaliation, intends to make the Peace Guild the world's greatest Guild, and accepts responsibility for the outcome.
Lee Jungryong's apparent concern for Jihoon was an act; he is calculating, ruthless, and willing to erase witnesses.
Park Tae Seop has been indebted to Lee Jungryong for roughly twenty years and committed crimes for him after receiving help during a financial crisis.
Lee's forces concealed the battle with sleep magic, illusion magic, and planned memory tampering.
Go Jun, also known as Team Leader Seok, is Lee Jungryong's prized Disciple and right-hand man.
Lee Jungryong ordered Go Jun to monitor Taekyung and personally intervene if Taekyung becomes a problem.
Lee Jungryong considers Taekyung an unusually dangerous opponent but has not stated what caused Taekyung's sudden growth.
Park Jihoon's eventual survival and recovery after Lee's order for minimal treatment remain unknown.
open_questions: What source or explanation does Lee Jungryong suspect for Taekyung's sudden growth and mana control?
Is Go Jun truly stronger than Jin Taekyung?
What will happen to Park Jihoon after Lee orders him treated only minimally and abandoned?
How will Park Tae Seop respond to Lee Jungryong's renewed threat and his own long-standing criminal obligation?
Is Lee Jungryong the unidentified 'that person,' and is Ares Guild directly behind the broader Black Hunter operation?
What happened to Team 11 after contact was lost?
What exact wrongdoing did Jung Hyunwoo uncover before Park Jihoon killed him?
Who authorized the Black Hunters to target the Peace Guild's D-rank Hunter?
